_description:
E-049b: ROAD B — the paper-faithful token. One pixel-bin becomes ONE 16-bit token: d_z 6, FSQ levels [8,8,8,5,5,5] (the arxiv 2309.15505 2^16 configuration — implicit codebook 64,000), fitted ladder, and an INTRINSIC BOUND on the pre-quantization activation. MEASURED PARAMS 37,956,471 (37.956M), identical to f4r2-40M-dz6 — the lattice and the bound add zero parameters, which is what makes the pair a one-variable contrast. 

THE THREE QUANTIZER SETTINGS ARE ONE COMPOSITE VARIABLE, declared as such (plan §2): (1) fsq_levels '8,8,8,5,5,5' — the paper's own 2^16 recommendation, at the paper's own regime of <10 dims, which E-046 deliberately declined at d_z 32 and road B now takes head-on; (2) fsq_ladder 'auto' with fsq_auto_step '50,200,2000,20000' — the per-dimension form+scale fit of a1de68f, refit up the step ladder so the checkpoint carries a lattice fitted to a settled distribution; (3) fsq_bound 'ln' — LayerNorm (no affine) on to_z's output before the lattice, the intrinsic bound the 08-25 design fork named. The bound is LOAD-BEARING, not a refinement: run-455 measured what an unbounded per-bin FSQ codec does (pre-quantization |v| ~ 3e4 against R=2 — the 8-level lattice worn as a ONE-BIT sign code), and e048a2 measured that the fitted ladder alone closes the collapse but not the drift (std_med 0.73 -> 20 across 28k steps, each fitted lattice outgrown in ~10k). At 16 nominal bits a sign-code degeneration leaves 6 effective bits and the experiment would be re-measuring a known disease. With the bound, prequant_rms = 1 and FLAT at every fit is the first-minutes health signal (NOT std_med: LayerNorm fixes each vector's rms, and a dimension carrying its energy in the mean legitimately reads a small per-dim std — measured rms 0.9998 / std_med 0.38 on the CPU toy); ml/fsq_usage.py measures EFFECTIVE bits per token (per-dim digit entropy) at every audit, so 'used 16' vs 'worn as fewer' is a measurement, never an inference from the levels argument. 

HYPOTHESIS AND FALSIFIER (plan §1, registered before dispatch): a typical Argo-free bin's live state (~8 fast channels, ~128 stored bits) fits in 16 bits well enough that the DECODER CEILING — the E-019b1 decoder-only retrain against the frozen tokens, the strongest non-linear decoder we run — reconstructs the fast channels on Argo-free bins at FVU within the month-block codec's accepted 9–19% band. FAIL: any fast channel at ~100% FVU at the ceiling — then 16 bits cannot carry a bin, this configuration is dead, and the pre-registered next rung is TWO tokens per bin (d_z 12 = the same levels twice, 32 bits), not a larger vocabulary. The Argo-carrying 8% of bins are EXPECTED to reconstruct badly (they already collapse at d_z 32: cur_speed 112%, ssh 86%) and are reported, not scored against the hypothesis. 

WHAT THIS ARM IS NOT: it is not a stage-2 experiment (no head is trained on it in this wave; token-input and token-output heads are separate later dispatches gated on this audit), and it is not E-046 (whose d_z-32 lattice keeps the width and changes only the alphabet — its verdict head #477 runs independently and neither result reads on the other's variable). 

DISPATCH with resume EMPTY, codec_steps 200000, batch 512, ~20 h / ~$6. Full design: ml/plans/E049_roadB_token.md.
_provenance: Copied field for field from ml/recipes/f4r2-40M-dz6.json (E-049a, itself f4r2-40M-nolonhold with d_z 6), adding exactly the quantizer block: fsq_levels '8,8,8,5,5,5', fsq_ladder 'auto', fsq_auto_step '50,200,2000,20000', fsq_bound 'ln'. fsq_bound and the fsq_auto_step recipe wiring are NEW at this commit (fsq_bound: LayerNorm without affine before the lattice, recorded in the checkpoint, refused by loaders that do not implement it and by the JAX trainer per the port's contract; fsq_auto_step existed in ml/train.py since a1de68f but no torch dispatch could set it). The evidence behind the bound is E-048's measured record: e048a collapse at |v|~87 vs R=2, run-455 saturation at |v|~3e4, e048a2 drift with no restoring force — and the experiment log's own 08-25 design fork, whose first branch this arm takes for the road-B line only (E-048's w6s3 arm stays HELD on its own fork). NOTHING HAS BEEN RUN AT THIS CONFIGURATION. ml/CLAUDE.md §3b applies in its harder form: a new codec, a new bottleneck width and a new bound at once — the first result buys its own replication before any number is a level.
